hypotheses: At fixed removed groups, the quality cost of retaining the Hamilton family can be measured against unrestricted physically compiled consumers, with their different size explicitly reported.

free_full_fit vs free_q_init isolates the compensation initialization at the same dense architecture and repair budget. free_q_init initially equals q_comp; their post-repair difference captures release of weight constraints, not a better initial compensation map.
The one-seed no-BN control asks whether compensation is useful when BN statistics cannot be stale. Its baseline/selection differ from BN; it does not causally isolate all effects of normalization.
decision_rules: Do not claim a new ridge/folding algorithm. The candidate contribution is a quantified structural-cost and capacity decomposition, not literature priority.
If full-fit advantage is explained by free_q_init after repair, attribute that part to extra optimization freedom; do not sell it as a better compensation method.
If Q has similar observed quality with fewer parameters, report the paired effects and uncertainty; no equivalence claim from n=3 or a small mean gap.
If unrestricted compiled models exceed the original QNN parameter budget, show negative savings. Equal width is not equal parameters or compute.

Report all outcomes and unfavorable seeds. No new architecture/activation sweep or test inference. Stop this registered study after the fixed two fractions; extra experiments need a separate scientific reason.
scope: Chosen after prior validation and final-test outcomes; new exploratory validation/check-calibration study, not a fresh blind confirmatory test. BN: both datasets, three existing source seeds; no-BN: CIFAR seed 2026 only. All six sites; same victims across four cases. For BN reuse original phase-A masks and existing Q initial/repair results, verifying reloads. For no-BN select Q greedy victims on its own 500-image fit half and freeze those lists for every case. Full maps are folded exactly into dense Conv2d consumers (five convs; first stays Q); no projection and no explicit runtime reconstruction branch. Global-average readout was already real. Full-map path refits after earlier changes. Both initial and final-epoch-three quality, CE, paired seeds, trainable real parameters, checkpoint bytes and original-Q-relative savings reported. Reused vs new training distinguished; equal attempted schedules do not prove equal successful AMP updates.
